items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: It was a novelty section, and the powerhouse was Willy Smith.

ctx.x: It was a novelty section, and the powerhouse was Willy Smith. And so that made it different from other bands, because he was so strong. He played saxophone so loud that we never did write any in the background, at no time, with the reeds.
You think he played too strong?
